end.parentNote: Asha practised reading flat, rising, and steeper sections of position-time and velocity-time graphs. Ira explained that a flat x-t graph means staying in the same position, while a flat v-t graph means constant velocity, and they used a v-t rectangle to find distance. There was a mix-up between slope and velocity; this was not clearly corrected before the lesson ended (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, ask Ira to explain in one sentence what the slope and area of a v-t graph represent.
